description: Full-SESSION model order for interactive free sessions (bin/launch-remote-window.sh consumers, e.g. motion-pipeline's 'Add motion graphics' step). Distinct from dispatch-preferences.json 'order': dispatch-first models (Gemini 3.8 Flash) lead STATELESS dispatches but must NOT lead a full session — their free quota burns inside minutes (user 2026-10-31, reaffirmed 2026-11-19 after a session launcher put Gemini on top and exhausted it). Order from the dispatch-preferences maintainer note: Mistral Large 4 is TOP PICK for full sessions (user 2026-10-29/31), then DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, StepFun Step 5 Preview, Nemotron 3 Ultra as fallback. Keep aliases in sync with the --inventory roster; entries missing there are skipped by consumers. (nvidia-deepseek-v4 dropped 2026-11-19: NVIDIA retired deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash 410 EOL 2026-11-16 — a retired id must never be in a fallback chain, same rule that removed z-ai/glm-5.3.) Session feasibility is MEASURED, not guessed: see docs/measurements/2026-11-20-remote-quota-probe.md (nvidia: no daily cap + 10 h in-session evidence; groq/mistral/openrouter per-minute caps only; gemini dispatch-only; the rest paid/exhausted/not permissioned as of 2026-11-20) — re-measure before changing this order.
